title: FP8 profile health + calibration robustness initiative for Hopper (E4M3/E5M2)
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Goal: Safely enable FP8 E4M3/E5M2 quantization profiles on Hopper inference fleet with deterministic, monitored calibration and an automated fallback path to INT8 when quality or stability regressions are detected. This ticket bundles: (1) pre-launch validation harness expansions, (2) cross-batch variance mitigation heuristics, (3) per-op scaling stabilization, (4) CI and canary gating metrics, and (5) an operational runbook for emergency rollbacks.
changes: Add cross-batch variance detector that computes moving-window scale variance and flags ops exceeding a tunable threshold
Introduce per-op stochastic smoothing: exponential moving average with adjustable decay and outlier clamp
Expand calibration pipeline to include adversarial seeds and prompt perturbation suite to expose brittle ops
Implement automatic fallback rule: if model-token-logprob-breach > threshold OR downstream eval drop > X% across canary shard then switch model variant to int8-fallback with hysteresis
Add CI smoke test that runs a 100-sample golden prompt set and validates token-distribution KL against baseline within tolerance
acceptance_criteria: Canary run across 5 shards for 48 hours with no more than 1% of requests tripping fallback rule
Golden-suite regression < 0.5% on chosen evals (LM loss and semantic QA recovery), measured end-to-end
Telemetry exposes per-op scale variance timeseries and alert when 99th percentile variance > configured threshold
Automation executes rollback to int8-fallback and confirms restored metrics within 30 minutes
test_plan: Unit tests for cross-batch variance detector (edge cases: small batch sizes, zero-length prefixes)
Integration test: calibration pipeline runs on a representative model snapshot with both E4M3 and E5M2 modes
Regression harness: run golden prompts (n=200) + adversarial perturbations, compare LM perplexity and top-1 accuracy for QA tasks
Load/perf smoke: ensure calibration layer adds <4ms median latency for short-chat traffic profiles
rollout_plan: Shadow run on dedicated canary fleet for 72 hours (no customer traffic) - smoke and regression checks
Dark-launch traffic split: 1% production traffic to FP8 with live logging but no billing impact
Progressive increase to 10% after 48-hour stability window; monitor LP loss / QA accuracy / tail latencies
If anomaly triggers fallback rule on >0.5% of requests across a 1-hour window, auto-revert to INT8-fallback and notify on-call
Full rollout gated by two consecutive 24-hour windows meeting acceptance criteria and SEV-zero for regressions
